title: SaldoInsuficienteException
description: Create a custom exception called SaldoInsuficienteException that extends Exception. Then create a CuentaBancaria class with a balance and depositar and retirar methods. The retirar method must throw SaldoInsuficienteException if the amount to withdraw is greater than the available balance.
hints: Create the SaldoInsuficienteException class that extends Exception and has a constructor that receives a String
In retirar, check whether monto > saldo before performing the operation
If there is not enough balance, throw new SaldoInsuficienteException with a message including the current balance
solutionExplanation: SaldoInsuficienteException is created as a class that extends Exception, with a constructor that accepts a message. The CuentaBancaria class has the retirar method that checks whether the requested amount exceeds the balance. If so, it throws the custom exception with an informative message. The first withdrawal of $500 succeeds (balance left at $500), but the second of $600 fails because it exceeds the available balance.
expectedOutput:
Withdrawal: $500.0 | Balance: $500.0
Insufficient balance. Current balance: $500.0, requested amount: $600.0

title: Exception with error code
description: Create a custom exception ErrorCodeException that extends Exception and has an int field codigoError. Its constructor must receive both the message and the code. Create a method validarOperacion that throws this exception with different codes: 1001 for null data, 1002 for invalid format, 1003 for access denied.
hints: The exception must have an int codigoError field and a getCodigoError() getter
The constructor must call super(mensaje) and assign this.codigoError = codigoError
In validarOperacion, check the conditions and throw ErrorCodeException with the corresponding code and message
In main, use e.getCodigoError() to show the numeric code along with the message
solutionExplanation: The ErrorCodeException exception extends Exception and adds a codigoError field with its getter. The validarOperacion method throws the exception with different codes: 1001 for null, 1002 for invalid format, 1003 for access denied. In main, each test runs in a try-catch where both the numeric code and the descriptive error message are shown.
expectedOutput:
Error [1001]: Data cannot be null
Error [1002]: Invalid data format: datos@invalidos
Error [1003]: Access denied for type: denegado
Valid operation. Data: datos123, Type: normal

title: Validator with hierarchical exceptions
description: Create an exception hierarchy: ValidationException (base class, extends Exception) with a 'campo' field and getter. Then EmailValidationException and AgeValidationException, both extending ValidationException. Create a method validarUsuario that throws EmailValidationException if the email does not contain '@' or is null, and AgeValidationException if the age is out of range [0, 150]. Catch each exception type separately.
hints: ValidationException must have a String campo field and a constructor that receives a message and a campo
EmailValidationException and AgeValidationException pass the field name ('email' or 'edad') to the parent constructor
In validarUsuario, check the email first and then the age, throwing the correct subtype exception
In main use separate catches for EmailValidationException and AgeValidationException
solutionExplanation: An exception hierarchy is created where ValidationException is the base class with a 'campo' field to identify which field failed. EmailValidationException and AgeValidationException are subclasses that pass the appropriate field name ('email' or 'edad') to the parent constructor. The validarUsuario method throws the correct subtype exception depending on which validation fails. In main, separate catches are used for each subtype, demonstrating polymorphism in exception handling.
expectedOutput:
Valid user - Email: ana@mail.com, Age: 25
Error in field [email]: Email cannot be null
Error in field [email]: Email must contain '@': bob
Error in field [edad]: Age must be between 0 and 150: -5
Error in field [edad]: Age must be between 0 and 150: 200
Error in field [email]: Email cannot be null
